guide_before_steps.title: Niyyah & Bismillah
guide_before_steps.detail: Make the intention (Niyyah) and say Bismillah. The session begins with the remembrance of Allah.

guide_before_steps.title: Fast or 3-hour gap
guide_before_steps.detail: No heavy food at least 3 hours before hijama. Fasting is ideal.

guide_before_steps.title: Ghusl & hygiene
guide_before_steps.detail: Body cleanliness is essential. Ghusl (full ritual bath) is recommended. Wear clean clothes.

guide_before_steps.title: Recite du'a
guide_before_steps.detail:
أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي
"Remove the ailment, O Lord of mankind, and heal — You are the Healer."

guide_before_steps.title: Sterilise equipment
guide_before_steps.detail: Fully disinfect cups, lancet/scalpel, and all materials. Prefer single-use items.

guide_before_steps.title: Calm environment
guide_before_steps.detail: Prepare a relaxed, clean, and warm environment. The person should lie in a comfortable position.

guide_during_steps.title: Dry cupping first
guide_during_steps.detail: Start with 3–5 minutes of dry cupping without incisions. Prepares the skin and promotes blood flow.

guide_during_steps.title: Small incisions (Al-Hayb)
guide_during_steps.detail: Only superficial cuts — no deeper than 1–2 mm. Only over the cupping zone, per Sunnah.

guide_during_steps.title: Reapply the cup
guide_during_steps.detail: Place the cup immediately after incisions. Suction draws out the blood (wet cupping — Al-Hijama).

guide_during_steps.title: Wait 3–5 minutes
guide_during_steps.detail: Cup sits for 3–5 minutes. The person should remain still and relaxed. Dhikr or du'a is encouraged.

guide_during_steps.title: Remove cup & clean
guide_during_steps.detail: Carefully remove the cup. The blood is dark — this is normal. Keep the wound area clean.

guide_after_steps.title: Clean & disinfect wounds
guide_after_steps.detail: Clean incisions immediately with antiseptic. Apply black seed oil (Habbatus Sauda) — Sunnah.

guide_after_steps.title: Black seed oil (Habbatus Sauda)
guide_after_steps.detail: Apply to the cupping sites. The Prophet ﷺ recommended black seed as a remedy.

guide_after_steps.title: Drink plenty of water
guide_after_steps.detail: Drink water or herbal tea immediately after. Keep the body well hydrated.

guide_after_steps.title: Rest for 24 hours
guide_after_steps.detail: No heavy physical work for at least 24 hours. The body needs recovery.

guide_after_steps.title: Cover cupping sites
guide_after_steps.detail: Use sterile bandages or clean cloths. Keep clean and dry until healed.

guide_after_steps.title: No shower immediately
guide_after_steps.detail: Wait at least 3–4 hours before showering or bathing. No hot water on the sites.

guide_after_steps.title: Light meal after 1–2 hours
guide_after_steps.detail: Eat lightly only after a rest period. Honey and dates are recommended (Sunnah foods).

points_sunnah_title: Sunnah Points (recommended by the Prophet ﷺ)

points.name: Al-Kahil
points.description: Between the shoulder blades — the main Sunnah point

points.name: Al-Akhda'ain (left)
points.description: Left side of the neck — jugular vein

points.name: Al-Akhda'ain (right)
points.description: Right side of the neck — jugular vein

points.name: Top of the head
points.description: Crown of the head — for headaches

points.name: Back of knees
points.description: Popliteal area — for knee and leg complaints

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ أَمْثَلَ مَا تَدَاوَيْتُمْ بِهِ الْحِجَامَةُ
hadiths.translation: The best treatment you can use is hijama (cupping).
The best of what you treat yourself with is hijama.

hadiths.arabic: احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي الأَخْدَعَيْنِ وَالْكَاهِلِ
hadiths.translation: The Prophet ﷺ had cupping done on the jugular veins and between the shoulder blades.

hadiths.arabic: مَنِ احْتَجَمَ لِسَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ أَوْ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ أَوْ إِحْدَى وَعِشْرِينَ كَانَتْ شِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
hadiths.translation: Whoever is cupped on the 17th, 19th or 21st of the month — it will be a cure for every disease, by Allah's permission.

hadiths.arabic: احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فِي رَأْسِهِ مِنْ شَقِيقَةٍ كَانَتْ بِهِ
hadiths.translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, while in a state of ihram, had cupping done on his head due to a migraine.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلَّا السَّامَ
hadiths.translation: In black seed (Habbatus Sauda) there is cure for every disease except death.

hadiths.arabic: الشِّفَاءُ فِي ثَلَاثَةٍ: شَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ، أَوْ شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ، أَوْ كَيَّةٍ بِنَارٍ
hadiths.translation: Healing lies in three things: the incision of the cupping instrument, drinking honey, or cauterisation — but I forbid my Ummah from cauterisation.
